Intent: Let callers count words with a zero-value Tally.
Head: b1b47484177aa6e7a3a1e396b084be341c4815f5
Diff:
diff --git a/tally/tally.go b/tally/tally.go
index d52f25d..e87725d 100644
--- a/tally/tally.go
+++ b/tally/tally.go
@@ -1,10 +1,15 @@
 package tally
 
-// Tally counts words.
+// Tally counts words. The zero value is ready to use.
 type Tally struct {
 	counts map[string]int
 }
 
+// Add records one occurrence of word.
+func (t *Tally) Add(word string) {
+	t.counts[word]++
+}
+
 // Count returns how many times word was added.
 func (t *Tally) Count(word string) int {
 	return t.counts[word]
diff --git a/tally/visible_test.go b/tally/visible_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..48ae140
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tally/visible_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+package tally
+
+import "testing"
+
+func TestCountEmpty(t *testing.T) {
+	var tl Tally
+	if got := tl.Count("a"); got != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("Count = %d, want 0", got)
+	}
+}

Selected.explanation: The type doc says the zero value is ready to use, but Add writes to the nil counts map and panics on a zero-value Tally.
Selected.action: Initialize counts in Add when it is nil.
